Next, I need to ensure my response is welcoming and open-ended. By stating that I don't have personal desires, I can redirect the focus to their needs. Encouraging them to ask questions or seek assistance will make the interaction more productive and user-centered.

Also, keeping the tone friendly and approachable is key. Avoiding jargon and using straightforward language will help build rapport. I'll make sure to emphasize that I'm designed to be a helpful tool, without any hidden agenda.

Finally, ending with an invitation to engage will prompt them to take the lead, ensuring they feel empowered to direct the conversation. This should create a positive and helpful exchange.
